entities.summary: The Iglesia de San Román is a church in Toledo. The church was built in the Mudéjar style in the 13th century. On this site there was an old Visigothic structure and probably an ancient Roman building. Church of San Román is a church building in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
